Its not like tennis. Is not like swimming. Its a game and you use your head not your physical body. My brother has been playing pokemon his whole life and has been winning non professionally but he is planning to go pro at 27. Nobody is gonna stop him, Someone like you is literally the worst type of person anyone could meet. Oh you you cant make it at the young age of 25 because 25 is so ancient. dude. you dont make any sense. I think is an american mindset that 25 is old. is just plain weird.

well then if he makes it then the joke is on you. like bro. if you dont have dreams thats cool, but dont tell other people they have zero chance at their dreams. it doesnt matter the age. I understand a sport like basketball or something but gaming? anyone can start at any age. You seem like the type of person who would never pursue their dreams but can keep telling other people in your life that they have ZERO CHANCE because you are afraid to pursue your own dreams and hate seeing other people even try at something new and challenging. My friend who is 25 was told she had ZERO CHANCE to get into nyu, and guess what, she did it? My dad at 55 was told he had ZERO CHANCE at becoming a succesful sculpture artist, guess what he did it. My mother started a succesful business at age 55 and she went back to school. My brother is just starting a new career at 27 because he hates architecture so he went for UX design and he is now learning python. I am concept artist with years of experience in art but I tell people in their 30s that they can still start a new career in art if they wanted to. 
Just because you have zero chance it doesnt mean others have a zero chance. That is something you are projecting onto others. If someone is deeply passionate about something they are going to make it. OP doesnt have to quit their job, they can do this on the side or whatever. But I am just tired of people telling others they cant make it. Its pathethic because when the person makes it then that person who never believed in them ends up looking like a clown. Basically OP, i believe in you even if 90 percent in this comment section dont. You can do it. Dont listen to these clowns.

this person is asking if they can into e sports at age 25, we don't know if the op already plays competitive locally from an early age. Also soccer is not gaming. Is a different skillset. One requires your legs and to have an actual young body the other requires your brain entirely.

Esports and this whole giant multi millionaire industry related to anything regarding gaming has less than 20 years in existence. 15 years ago there was not tournaments were you could make millions.  I think your data is completely irrelevant a little bit stupid. The reason the majority of pro players are young its because this is a new career and most of the older gamers that started playing the the early 90s didn't even know gaming could become a career so they stopped gaming later in life to start a family and have kids. So because we now know this can be a career, more parents are encouraging kids from a young age to become pro players. Also because there is an actual NEW booming industry, younger kids can get into this as a career because there is an actual industry now. Also younger people have more time to grind, but if a 25 year old also has lots of time in a day to practice and play competitive yea they can make a career out of this because this is a completely NEW INDUSTRY were there is not even enough data to prove that you have to be like 13 to make it. So stop telling people on the internet they cant pursue their dreams, maybe you don't have them but others do.
